boundary: This amendment corrects what the completed numbers are called. It does not re-measure, re-derive, promote, demote or replace any of them, and it turns no historical GO into a new numerical verdict.
name: native_audio_transfer_three_modality_verdict

terminology_changes.corrected_wording: in a six-way forced choice whose options are named in the prompt, the concept's complete-sequence likelihood exceeded the other five
terminology_changes.original_wording: the model can read the concept out of this channel
terminology_changes.reason: the gate is multiple-choice evidence. Open recognition was never measured, and no vocabulary row outside the six was consulted

terminology_changes.corrected_wording: changed the target concept's conditional log-probability in the expected direction [CONTROLLED_TARGET_LOGPROB_EFFECT; FULL_VOCABULARY_NOT_EVALUATED]
terminology_changes.original_wording: moved the target concept in the expected direction
terminology_changes.reason: a controlled likelihood effect is a real causal result and is not evidence that any output token changed
the flag records which of the six supplied candidates scored highest, before and after; it is not a change of output

the verdict string is immutable and is reproduced verbatim; the endpoint labels are added beside it. The existing candidate-conditioned limitation from the prompt-protocol rule still applies and is unchanged by this amendment
